summary: Data Sonic turns NASA data into sound, so blind and low-vision people can explore climate maps by ear. A playhead scans a map, the color legend recovers real values, and those values become pitch, volume and stereo position on a musical scale. We measure how accurate the image-derived values are against the original NASA data.
